privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Cross-project audit procedure
goal: docs/agents/cross-project-audit.md exists as a project procedure, linked from the AGENTS.md procedures table (like gap-review), and run together with the gap review
acceptance: it checks five things: (1) cross-references, a step that depends on another repository's step that is closed, cancelled or missing; (2) decisions, a plan in any repository that contradicts a later decision in docs/DOMAINS.md or the solution order; (3) contracts, MCP producer against consumer expectations (grover alerts against nerv:F-122; fpvbuddy tools against nerv:F-101-T08 to T10); (4) duplication across repositories, reusing the F-016-T02 checks by reference, not copying them; (5) audit cadence, repositories overdue or never fully audited
findings become proposals to the owning repository and are reported to the owner under the gap-review procedure; the coordinator edits no component

2026-11-26 note: the acceptance first said the procedure is linked from docs/agents/procedures.md; that was a mistake in the owner's brief. The link is the AGENTS.md procedures table row, like gap-review, so procedures.md stays a copied harness file.

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed for coordinator-only work, from the size of the gap-review procedure and the F-016 steps of similar scope. Not a measurement.
